decisions: Clarify whether the buyer needs shipping packaging, retail packaging, gift packaging, paper bags, mailers or inserts.
Prepare product category, dimensions, quantity range, material direction, print coverage, artwork status and target sales channel before RFQ.
Do not ask only for generic packing item prices; define the packaging role and product fit first.
